name: Valavupara - Kacherikkadavu - Palathumkadavu Road

tollInfo.note: District roads in India are not tolled.

significance: MDR, Valavupara - Kacherikkadavu - Palathumkadavu Road, crosses the border between Kerala and Karnataka. A state road that runs through more than one state has no single owner — Kerala PWD and Karnataka PWD each maintain the stretch inside their own state, so which department to contact depends on where along the road you are.
